name: inset-sidebar-shell
title: Inset sidebar shell
description: An app frame with the sidebar on the page background and the page as a bordered, rounded surface beside it, scrolling on its own under a breadcrumb header.
docs: Pass your navigation as nav (a SidebarNav is itself the navigation landmark), the account button as footer, and breadcrumbs and actions as header. The page scrolls inside the surface, so the sidebar never moves. Below md the sidebar opens as a left sheet from the menu button and closes when a link is followed. Below lg only the last breadcrumb stays, because the header has no room for a trail that would shrink to a few letters. The first pixels of a scrolled page fade under the header; at rest nothing fades, so padded={false} suits a full-bleed table. The shell is as tall as its container: it is h-dvh unless you pass a height in className. Pass linkAs for your router link and mainId when the page already uses id=main.
